title: Isolation of new periodontal-associated bacterial species using Culturomics - A comparison of microbiome analysis employing "Next Generation Sequencing (NGS)
summary:
Background: isolation/cultivation of new bacterial species in the mouth.
research question: To what extent does the microbial composition differ between plaque samples taken above the gumline and those taken from periodontal pockets in people with periodontitis?
Methodology: cultivation of the samples on a variety of culture media as well as under different conditions and the subsequent examination and identification via sequencing.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1 tooth per patient with persisting probing pocket depth ≥ 6 mm. Periodontal recall patients.
Exclusion criteria:
Systemic diseases, intake of antibiotics/antimycotics, compromised immune system, smoking, pregnancy/nursing, participation in other clinical studies.
